direction: Evolve the static pairwise merge score within the globally-normalized generalized-savings family: score(i,j) = (d0i + d0j - lam*d_ij + mu*|d0i - d0j|)/mean(d0[1:]) + beta*clip((q_i+q_j)/Q,0,1), searching lam in [1.00,1.15], mu in [0.08,0.15], beta in [0.05,0.15], with mandatory single global depot-distance scale (strictly avoid per-pair (d0i+d0j) normalization), and combine the evolved merge starting point with a relocate_2opt descent postprocess (affordable because the vectorized hook runs in <0.4 ms, leaving the full 500 ms budget for local search).

operations.mechanism: KB entry method-cvrp-m2-l2a-generalized-savings is the verified elite for exactly this template/hook (dev_24 = 16.1398 with postprocess 'none', select_64 = 20.8236, blind_120 = 24.2003, 100% budget completion at p50 2.45 ms). Its documented invariant is a single global scale mean(d[0,1:]) plus lam/mu/beta correction terms, and its documented anti-pattern (evidence-cvrp-m2-perpair-scale-normalization-antipattern) shows per-pair normalization catastrophically destroys radial priority, so evolution is confined to lam/mu/beta (and safe equivalents) rather than re-parameterizing the normalization. The same entry flags the untested combination with local search as the open question: 'none' postprocess was used only to isolate construction-layer gains; with the hook costing <0.4 ms inside a 500 ms budget there is ample headroom, so relocate_2opt (documented standard CVRP 1-0 inter-route relocate alternating with intra-route 2-opt, historically giving CW 16.2225 -> 16.1549) is the cheapest high-expected-value addition. Because relocate_2opt is a descent operator, it cannot worsen a valid merged solution, making this a low-risk complement rather than a bet against the verified construction rule. Budget: 500 ms per instance with ~2-12 ms baseline leaves >95% slack for the local descent, so no timeout-truncation risk like the 25 ms regime observed for the dynamic L2b variant.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: A globally depot-distance-normalized generalized savings score (with radial asymmetry term mu*|d0i-d0j| and dimensionless capacity-fill bonus beta) preserves far-customer radial merge priority and scale invariance, reaching ~16.14 mean tour length on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 with postprocess 'none'; layering relocate_2opt on top of that evolved merge start should strictly improve or tie per instance (descent-only local search) and approach or beat the 16.1398 no-postprocess incumbent as well as CW+relocate_2opt (16.1549), since the merged starting solution is of higher quality than bare CW while relocate_2opt removes residual inter-route waste that the static pairwise layer cannot see.
